title: Studio's key-fields editor still previews a highlights strip the default record page no longer draws
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found by area b1-DB while building #35943 (PR #35977). Part of epic #35590 (record page redo): the maintainer removed the stage bar and the key-fields strip from the default record page (#35891 + #35849, PR #35938).

## What a user sees
In Studio's object settings, the key-fields editor (`HighlightFieldsEditor`) still draws a "Highlight strip preview", and its help says the fields show "in the order the record page displays them". The default record page no longer draws that strip, so an admin who sets key fields expecting a strip sees nothing change on the page.

## To do
1. In `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/HighlightFieldsEditor.tsx` (and `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` / `RelatedListsEditor.tsx` where they share the wording), drop the strip preview and rewrite the help to say what `highlightFields` does now, matching the descriptions #35943 rewrites in the spec.
2. Update the `engine.studio.settings.highlightPreview` key and its neighbours in every locale pack: remove the key if the preview goes, or give it real text in all locales.
3. Rider: `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` (a smoke spec CI does not run) still expects the stage bar and key-fields strip on the default page. Align it with the current page.

Not in scope: ADR-0085 and semantic migration entry `18.field-group-shadowed-six-highlights` still describe the strip. ADR text goes to the weekly ADR-revision card, not this one.

## Acceptance
- The key-fields editor shows no strip preview and its help matches what the default record page does.
- No locale pack keeps a key the UI no longer reads.

Blocked-by: #35977 (the spec descriptions this copy should match).
Reader: area:ux (ui/packages/app-shell studio-design, i18n).
